title: Computer zoom panning: automated verification passed
summary: Verified bounded two-axis dragging, tap preservation, drag click suppression, pointer cancellation, keyboard movement and full-view reset.

changes.detail: Dragging now scrolls the zoomed photo with bounded movement and suppresses accidental component clicks.
Keyboard arrow panning, focus outline and grab cursor. Full view retains normal page scrolling.

validation.name: Focused interaction and regression tests
validation.detail: 15 tests passed: pan interaction in English, French and Arabic, component lessons, layer interactions, and change-history UI/archive tests. JSDOM uses simulated layout dimensions.

validation.name: Focused lint
validation.detail: Both modified TypeScript files passed ESLint. The CJS test is ignored by repository ESLint configuration and was executed with node --test.

validation.name: Device/browser validation
validation.detail: Physical phone touch gestures and browser layout were not manually verified. No deployment or preview claimed.
